newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones, ITT to launch WBIS+ in January.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones, ITT to launch WBIS+ in January.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co and ITT Corp said on Wednesday they would launch their WBIS+ Channel 31 television station on January 21.
The station would broadcast 24 hours a day, providing comprehensive programming to serve New York City and the surrounding region, the companies said.
The two companies bought the station from the city of New York for $207 million during the summer.

Business, news and information programming would originate from the S+ Studios at the World Financial Center in New York, while live financial news coverage would be telecast from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange and from the Wall Street Journal newsroom, the companies said.
